public.heroTitle: The blood needed, the donors who are ready.
public.heroBody: Nadi Kita connects UTD blood inventory with donors who have passed the 60-day recovery period, complete with 30-minute time slots.
public.step1Body: Coordinators update unit counts across eight blood groups. Low or critical groups are flagged immediately.
public.step2Body: The system filters out donors still in their 60-day recovery window and ranks eligible candidates.
public.step3Body: Donors complete a 4-question pre-check and reserve a 30-minute slot within capacity.
public.step4Body: Staff scan the QR ticket upon arrival and mark completion to reset the 60-day recovery timer.
